accuracy.owner_report: Slugs always land a little bottom-right of the aim
accuracy.cause: Gravity. Slugs fall short while still on the gun's side of the crosshair line. Calculated flat-aim drop at 20 studs: 4.3 tap, 1.2 full.
accuracy.fix: Launch along the arc that passes through the crosshair's point (Combat.aimedDirection), using the same flight model the server judges. Tuning aimArc: 1 on, 0 off.

after_tap.55: out of reach, falls short on the line

accuracy.third_person_after: Same, within 0.10 studs right and 0.17 up wherever in reach
limits: Stationary shooter and wall. Moving targets still need leading.
Open sky has nothing to land on, so those shots fly straight.

smooth_windup.implemented: Sharp jolts replaced by eased steps that hold: gun moves back and up, view tightens to 3.5 degrees, soft swell on each step; vibration 3.5x while moving
smooth_windup.not_verified: Feel; not re-measured in play after the rework beyond the accuracy run
